content:
The International English Language Testing System, popularly known as IELTS is a proficiency test in English. Securing a good IELTS band score will help people to study or migrate to an English speaking country. In IELTS, one’s ability to handle the four skills: listening, speaking, reading and writing is assessed. Casper is a leading IELTS institute in Ernakulam that provides intensive coaching.

Some General Myths:

  • One of the greatest myths about IELTS is that it is a one time opportunity. There are no restrictions on the number of times that a candidate can appear for the IELTS test. But there is a basic criterion that a student can attempt a maximum of two tests a month.
  • Another myth that is widespread is that a student has to score a minimum of 7 to pass an IELTS test. IELTS is not concerned with pass or fail. It measures the proficiency of a student. If a student scores a required band score to get into a university, he or she is successful. Our IELTS coaching in Kochi trains you to perform excellently. If you can get into the desired programme, you can say that you have passed. Different courses and universities require different band scores.
  • Some people believe that IELTS tests are different for different countries. Though IELTS is commonly classified into two, IELTS Academic and IELTS General Training, both versions are the same all around the world. Thus the testing pattern of IELTS is universal.

Speaking Myths

  • It is believed that accent should be given much importance. But that’s not true. The examiners are not concerned about the accent of the student. They are only concerned with the accuracy with which you answer the questions; both in writing as well as speaking tests.
  • One of the myths that circulate widely is that the students are required to speak in an ornamental language. It is not true as the examiners check whether you speak formally in error-free english. By providing the best IELTS training in Cochin, we give tips to improve speaking skills.

Listening Myths

  • The students will be given individual headsets for the listening test is one of the false beliefs. Some testing centers may provide, but the others will not. Some exam centers use speakers.
  • People say that there is no need to focus on listening section. But all sections are equally important. Students should read and listen to the instructions properly. Many ought to make mistakes because of not having a proper understanding of the instructions.

Reading Myths

  • Though it is not easy to find answers in the reading section, some believe it is an easy task! The answers will not be given directly in the passage. The student has to read and understand everything properly. Our IELTS institute in Ernakulam has notable excellence in coaching.
  • Can you believe when people say reading section is not time consuming? It is one of the most time consuming sections as it takes time to read the passages clearly.

Writing Myths

  • Word count needs to be strictly followed is another myth. It is okay to exceed word limit, but the examiners will not value the extra writing.
